# Search/Split String — missing

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

An exact byte substring search returns the prefix and matching suffix. A missing match returns offset -1 and an empty matching suffix.

## What this example demonstrates

An exact byte substring search returns the prefix and matching suffix. A missing match returns offset -1 and an empty matching suffix.
